public.how.title: Go tloga ka letsatsi la go jala go ya kwa kgatong
public.how.lead: Gantsi kgato e tsenngwa ka seatla, ka jalo e nna mo nakong fela go fitlha ka ntšhwafatso ya bofelo. Fano e balwa ka maemo a bosa a a rekotilweng, mme phetogo nngwe le nngwe e boloka bosupi jwa yone.
public.step.1.title: Rekota se molemi a se itseng
public.step.1.body: Dipolase, masimo, dijalo le matlha a go jala di bolokwa mo Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Tsaya maemo a bosa a a fetileng
public.step.2.body: Dithempheretšha tsa letsatsi le letsatsi tsa lefelo la tshimo di tswa mo direkotong tsa Open-Meteo, go tloga ka letsatsi la go jala go fitlha gompieno.
public.step.3.title: Tlhakanya malatsi a mogote
public.step.3.body: Malatsi a mogote wa kgolo (GDD) a tlhakanngwa go ya ka mmotlolo wa sejalo. Fa selekanyo se fetwa, tsamaiso e fetisetsa setlha kwa kgatong e e latelang mme e rekota lebaka.
public.models.title: Meotlolo ya dijalo e e dirisiwang
public.models.lead: Malatsi a mogote a a tlhokegang gore sejalo se butswe ka mogote. Dipharametara tseno di kwadilwe ka seatla mme ga di ise di nne le metswedi.
public.live.title: Maemo kwa polaseng ya teko ya Swartland
public.live.lead: Ditekanyo di tswa mo metsweding ya botlhe, mme di ntšhwafadiwa metsotso mengwe le mengwe e le 30.
public.yields.title: Dipalopalo tsa thobo tse di phasaladitsweng
public.honesty.title: Kafa tshedimosetso e tshwarwang ka teng
public.honesty.1.title: Thobo e tsenngwa ke modirisi
public.honesty.1.body: Go fitlha modiri a kwala thobo, app e bontsha “Ga e a kwalwa”.
public.honesty.2.title: Dipalo tsa papiso di bolokwa di le nosi
public.honesty.2.body: Dipalo tsa kgaolo le tsa naga di bolokwa mo ditokomaneng tsa tsone, di na le motswedi le yuniti. Ga di bapisiwe le thobo ya tshimo.
public.honesty.3.title: Direkoto tsa disenyi ke tsa kgaolo
public.honesty.3.body: Direkoto tsa GBIF di bontsha kwa disenyi di bonweng teng mo sekgaleng sa 100 km, le gore di bokgakala bo bokae.
public.honesty.4.title: Maemo a bosa ke a ga jaana
public.honesty.4.body: Dithemperetšha di tsewa mo polokelong ya Open-Meteo fa di kopiwa.
public.open.title: Bula setlha
public.open.body: Tsena mo dashboard ya teko go bona mola wa GDD wa setlha le bosupi jwa kgato ya sone.

public.about.title: Ka ga rona
public.about.heading: Ka ga Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ke sediriswa sa go sala masimo le dijalo morago mo polaseng ya Kapa Bophirima.
public.about.why.title: Lebaka la go dirwa ga yone
public.about.why.body: Dikgato tsa tshimo di a siiwa ke nako, mme thobo e kwalwa go tswa mo mogopolong. Mecropolis e bala kgato ka maemo a bosa a a rekotilweng. Palo nngwe le nngwe e tswa mo modiring kgotsa mo motsweding wa botlhe o o umakilweng.
public.about.design.title: Tsela e e dirilweng ka yone
public.about.design.1.body: Growing degree days di kokoanngwa go simolola ka letlha la go jala, go dirisiwa polokelo ya Open-Meteo. Phetogo nngwe le nngwe ya kgato e boloka bosupi: letlha le e simolotseng ka lone, palogotlhe ya GDD le se e badilweng ka sone.
public.about.design.2.body: Kgato e e latelang ya pele ga thobo e bidiwa go butswa ka mogote, ka gonne tiragalo ya thobo ga e a kwalwa.
public.about.design.4.lead: Dipalo tsa papiso di naya bokao.
public.about.design.4.body: Di bolokwa mo ditokomaneng tsa tsone, di na le motswedi, yuniti le laesense.
public.about.stack.title: Thekenoloji e e dirisitsweng
public.about.stack.body: Ke app ya tsebe e le nngwe ya Vite le React 19 mo Cloudflare Pages. Browser e bala tshedimosetso ya botlhe ya Sanity ka tlhamalalo ka GROQ le sediriswa se se reetsang diphetogo ka nako ya tsone. Go kwala le tshedimosetso e e tlhokang senotlolo di feta ka Cloudflare Pages Functions, tse di tlhatlhobang session cookie e e saennweng. Zod e tlhatlhoba tshedimosetso fa e tsena le fa e tswa, Vitest e dira diteko, mme Tailwind 4 e dira tebego.
public.about.limits.title: Mefokolo e e itsiweng
public.about.limits.1: Dipalo tsa mofuta wa sejalo (themperetšha ya motheo, mogote o o tlhokegang go tlhoga le go butswa) di kwadilwe ka seatla mme ga di ise di nne le metswedi.
public.about.limits.2: Palo ya papiso ya lupin e tswa mo HarvestStat ya 2000 go ya go 2007 fela, mme go tsenngwa ga ntlha ga tshedimosetso ga go a bona ditokomane tsa papiso tsa lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Tshedimosetso ya disenyi ke direkoto tsa GBIF tse di gaufi le polase. Di bontsha kwa mofuta mongwe o rekotilweng teng gaufi le polase.
public.about.limits.4: Teko e dirisa akhaonto e le nngwe e e dirisiwang ke botlhe le selekanyetsi sa dikopo se se mo memoring. Go tsena go fitlha ditsebe tsa dashboard, mme ga go sireletse tshedimosetso: botlhe ba ka e bala. Go sireletsa sengwe le sengwe se se kwalwang.

docs.stages.title: Tsamaiso ya dikgato
docs.stages.intro: Ditlha di fetela pele ka dikgato di le thataro:
docs.stages.guards: Phetogo nngwe le nngwe e na le se e se tlhokang. Kgato ya go jalwa e tlhoka letlha la go jala le sejalo; ya go gola e tlhoka selekanyo sa degree days sa go tlhoga; ya pele ga thobo e tlhoka 90% ya selekanyo sa go butswa; ya go butswa ka mogote e tlhoka gore selekanyo sa go butswa se fitlhelelwe; ya tshekatsheko e tlhoka setshwantsho sa maemo a bosa sa setlha le palo ya papiso e e tlhomamisitsweng. GDD gape e tlhoka tshedimosetso ya themperetšha ya bonnye 90% ya paka, mme phetogo e letlha la yone le leng kwa pele ga e letlelelwe.

guide.title: Mokgwa wa go dirisa Mecropolis
guide.lead: Kaedi e khutshwane ka mafoko a a bonolo. E tlhalosa gore app e diretswe eng, e diretswe mang le gore karolo nngwe le nngwe e dira eng.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ke eng
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ke app ya go sala masimo le dijalo morago. E bala gore sejalo se godile go le kana kang ka go kokoanya mogote o se o boneng fa e sale se jalwa. Gape e bontsha maemo a bosa, mmu le disenyi tse di gaufi le polase ya gago mo lefelong le le lengwe.
guide.what.p2: E diretswe dipolase tsa Kapa Bophirima mo Aforika Borwa, mme e ka dirisiwa mo polaseng nngwe le nngwe, mo kgaolong nngwe le nngwe le mo pakeng nngwe le nngwe.
guide.who.title: E diretswe mang
guide.who.p1: E diretswe motho yo o tlhokomelang masimo, jaaka molemi, molaodi wa polase kgotsa mogakolodi wa bone.
guide.who.p2: Ga o tlhoke go itse ka dikhomphiutha kgotsa saense ya maemo a bosa. Fa o kgona go bula webosaete, o ka dirisa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Goreng o ka e dirisa
guide.why.1: O ka bona ka bonako gore ke dijalo dife tse di sa tswang go jalwa, tse di golang le tse di batlang di siametse go rojwa.
guide.why.2: Ga o tlhoke go fetola tshimo nngwe le nngwe ka seatla. App e isa sejalo kwa kgatong e e latelang fa maemo a bosa a bontsha gore nako e gorogile.
guide.why.3: E go tlhagisa ka segagane le mogote mo malatsing a a tlang, le ka disenyi tse di bonweng gaufi le polase ya gago.
guide.why.4: Tshedimosetso yotlhe ya tshimo, jaaka go gasa, senyi se o se boneng kgotsa ntlhakgolo, e nna mo lefelong le le lengwe le letlha la yone gore o e lebe gape moragonyana.
guide.why.5: Palo nngwe le nngwe e bontsha kwa e tswang teng, gore o itse gore o ka tshepa eng.
guide.heat.title: App e itse jang gore sejalo se mo kgatong efe
guide.heat.p1: Dijalo di gola ka bonako fa go le mogote, mme ka bonya fa go le tsididi. Mecropolis e bala mogote ono letsatsi le letsatsi ka diyuniti tsa mogote, tse borasaense ba di bitsang growing degree days kgotsa GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Letsatsi le letsatsi e tsaya bogare jwa themperetšha e e kwa godimo le e e kwa tlase, e bo e ntsha themperetšha e sejalo se emisang go gola mo go yone. Se se salang ke diyuniti tsa mogote tsa letsatsi leo. Letsatsi le le tsididi ga le oketse sepe.
guide.heat.p3: Sejalo sengwe le sengwe se tlhoka palogotlhe e e rileng ya diyuniti tsa mogote pele se siamela go rojwa. Fa palogotlhe ya fa e sale se jalwa e atamela palo eo, sejalo se fetela kwa kgatong e e latelang.
guide.heat.p4: Dithemperetšha di tswa mo Open-Meteo, tirelo ya mahala e e rekotang maemo a bosa mo lefatsheng lotlhe.
guide.stages.title: Dikgato tse thataro
guide.stages.intro: Sejalo sengwe le sengwe mo tshimong nngwe le nngwe se feta mo dikgatong tseno ka tatelano eno.
guide.stages.planning: Paka e rulagantswe, mme sejalo ga se ise se jalwe.
guide.stages.planted: Letlha la go jala le fetile.
guide.stages.growing: Sejalo se kokoanya diyuniti tsa mogote.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Sejalo se kokoantse bontsi jwa mogote o se o tlhokang, ka jalo ke nako ya go ipaakanyetsa thobo.
guide.stages.harvested: Sejalo se kokoantse mogote otlhe o se o tlhokang, ka jalo se tshwanetse sa bo se siametse go rojwa. Ke wena fela o ka tlhomamisang gore se rojilwe, ka jalo app e bitsa seno go butswa ka mogote.
guide.stages.review: Paka e fedile mme o ka leba gore e tsamaile jang.
guide.stages.p2: App e tlhola sejalo sengwe le sengwe bosigo bongwe le bongwe le nako nngwe le nngwe fa mongwe a tsenya se a se boneng kgotsa tiro e e dirilweng. Gape o ka tobetsa Reconcile now mo pakeng gore e tlhole ka bonako.
guide.start.title: Go simolola
guide.start.1: Bula tsebe ya ntlha. O ka bona mmapa wa maemo a bosa, mmu, disenyi le thobo tsa polase ya teko o sa tsena.
guide.start.2: Tobetsa Sign in kwa godimo, o bo o dirisa dintlha tsa akhaonto ya teko tse o di neilweng.
guide.start.3: Tlhopha polase. Seno se bula dashboard ya polase eo.
guide.start.4: Tobetsa paka go bona tsotlhe ka sejalo seo mo tshimong eo.
guide.start.5: Dirisa lebokoso la puo kwa godimo ga tsebe nngwe le nngwe go fetola puo. App e tla gakologelwa tlhopho ya gago mo nakong e e tlang.
guide.home.title: Tsebe ya ntlha
guide.home.p1: Tsebe ya ntlha e bontsha mmapa wa kgaolo o o takilweng go ya ka mogote o lefatshe le o boneng mo pakeng eno. Gape e bontsha maemo a bosa a jaanong le a malatsi a a tlang, mmu wa polase ya teko, disenyi tse di sa tswang go bonwa gaufi le palogare ya thobo ya kgaolo. Ga o tlhoke go tsena gore o e bone.
guide.dashboard.title: Dashboard ya polase
guide.dashboard.intro: Dashboard e bontsha polase e le nngwe. Tseno ke dikarolo tsa yone go tswa kwa godimo go ya kwa tlase. Lebokoso la polase kwa godimo le go letla go ya kwa polaseng e nngwe.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Kakaretso ya polase
guide.dashboard.summary: Palo ya masimo le diheketara tsa polase, dipaka tse di tsweletseng le dijalo tse di siametseng go rojwa.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Se se tlhokang tlhokomelo
guide.dashboard.alerts: Dikitsiso tse dikhutshwane, jaaka segagane kgotsa mogote mo ponelopeleng, sejalo se se siametseng go rojwa, paka e e sa simololang ka nako kgotsa disenyi tse di bonweng gaufi le tshimo. Kitsiso nngwe le nngwe e tlhalosa se se e bakileng.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Maemo a polase
guide.dashboard.conditions: Maemo a bosa a gompieno, ponelopele, mmu le disenyi tse di gaufi le polase eno.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Kgatelopele ya paka
guide.dashboard.progress: Karata ya sejalo sengwe le sengwe e e bontshang gore se kokoantse mogote o le kana kang. O ka bapisa masimo mme wa folosa lenaane jaaka faele ya spreadsheet (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Masimo
guide.dashboard.fields: Masimo otlhe a polase le bogolo jwa one, mmu le dijalo tsa one.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Batla direkoto
guide.dashboard.search: Kwala se o se batlang ka mafoko a tlwaelo, jaaka ditshenekegi tsa aphid mo korong. E batla dilo tse di bonweng le ditiro tse di rayang selo se le sengwe, le fa go dirisitswe mafoko a mangwe.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Dikakantsho
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Tiro e e akantshiwang mo tshimong, jaaka go gasa kgotsa go tsenya monontsha. O ka amogela kgotsa wa gana nngwe le nngwe, mme wa e tshwaya e fedile fa tiro e dirilwe.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Ditiragalo tsa bosheng
guide.dashboard.activity: Lenaane la dinako tse sejalo sengwe le sengwe se fetetseng kwa kgatong e ntšha.
guide.season.title: Tsebe ya paka
guide.season.intro: Paka ke sejalo se le sengwe mo tshimong e le nngwe mo ngwageng o le mongwe. Tsebe ya yone e na le tsotlhe ka ga yone.
guide.season.top.label: Kwa godimo ga tsebe
guide.season.top: Sejalo, tshimo, letlha la go jala, letlha le le solofetsweng la thobo le thobo fa o sena go e tsenya.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Tatelano ya dikgato
guide.season.pipeline: Dikgato tse thataro, mme ya jaanong e tshwailwe. Tobetsa Reconcile now go tlhola ka bonako gore a sejalo se tshwanetse go fetela pele.
guide.season.readiness.label: A se siametse go fetela pele
guide.season.readiness: Lenaane la dilo tse app e di tlhokang pele e ka isa sejalo kwa kgatong e e latelang, jaaka letlha la go jala le tshedimosetso e e lekaneng ya maemo a bosa. Ntlha nngwe le nngwe e re Pass, Warning kgotsa Blocked. E e thibetsweng e go bolelela se se tlhaelang.
guide.season.evidence.label: Bosupi
guide.season.evidence: Direkoto tse app e di dirisitseng go dira ditshwetso, gore o kgone go di tlhola.
guide.season.propose.label: Akantsha tiro
guide.season.propose: Akantsha tiro ya tshimo eno mme o tsenye bosupi jwa paka. E nna e le kakantsho go fitlha mongwe a e amogela mo dashboard.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Tšhate ya diyuniti tsa mogote tse di kokoanang fa e sale go jalwa, e na le mola wa palogotlhe e sejalo se e tlhokang.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Go ka diragalang fa?
guide.season.whatIf: Leka letlha la go jala la pele kgotsa la moragonyana, kgotsa paka e e mogote kgotsa e e tsididi, mme o bone gore diyuniti tsa mogote di ka fetoga jang. Ga go sepe se se bolokwang.
guide.season.summary.label: Kakaretso ya paka
guide.season.summary: Kakaretso e khutshwane ya direkoto tsa paka e e kwadilweng ke AI. E dirise jaaka mothusi, mme o tlhole direkoto fa sengwe se lebega se sa siama.
guide.season.notes.label: Dintlhakgolo tsa paka
guide.season.notes: Dintlhakgolo tsa paka tse di nang le matlha. O ka di tsenya, wa di fetola kgotsa wa di phimola, mme wa busetsa mofuta wa bogologolo.
guide.season.files.label: Setshwantsho sa tshimo le pego ya teko ya mmu
guide.season.files: Tsenya setshwantsho sa tshimo le PDF ya teko ya mmu e e tswang kwa laboratoring.
guide.season.log.label: Rekoto ya tshimo
guide.season.log: Se o se boneng mo tshimong le se o se dirileng mo go yone, jaaka go gasa le leina la seokobatsi le selekanyo sa sone.
guide.season.history.label: Hisitori ya diphetogo
guide.season.history: Phetogo nngwe le nngwe e e bolokilweng mo pakeng eno le letlha la yone.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Palogare ya kgaolo
guide.season.benchmark: Palogare ya thobo ya kgaolo e e tswang mo dipalopalong tsa botlhe. Ke ya go bapisa fela, ga se thobo ya tshimo ya gago.
guide.season.pests.label: Disenyi tse di bonweng mo kgaolong
guide.season.pests: Disenyi tse di begilweng gaufi le tshimo mo GBIF, polokelo ya botlhe ya ditshupo. Tobetsa Fetch sightings go bona tsa bosheng.
guide.sources.title: Dipalo di tswa kae
guide.sources.weather: Maemo a bosa a tswa mo Open-Meteo, a gompieno, ponelopele le malatsi a a fetileng.
guide.sources.soil: Tshedimosetso ya mmu e tswa mo SoilGrids, mmapa wa lefatshe wa mmu.
guide.sources.pests: Ditshupo tsa disenyi di tswa mo GBIF, polokelo ya botlhe ya ditshupo.
guide.sources.yields: Thobo ya kgaolo e tswa mo USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa le World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Tse dingwe tsotlhe, jaaka dintlhakgolo, ditiro le thobo ya gago, ke tse wena kgotsa setlhopha sa gago le di tsentseng.
guide.limits.title: Se e ka se kang ya se dira
guide.limits.model: Diyuniti tsa mogote tse sejalo sengwe le sengwe se di tlhokang ke dikakanyetso tsa rona mme ga di ise di lekwe mo tshimong. Di dirise jaaka kaedi, mme o tshepe se o se bonang mo tshimong ya gago.
guide.limits.maturity: Go butswa ka mogote go raya gore maemo a bosa a bontsha gore sejalo se tshwanetse go bo se siametse go rojwa. Ke wena fela o itseng gore a se butsitse tota.
guide.limits.translation: Dithanolo di kwadilwe ke AI. Di tshwanetse go nna motlhofo go di tlhaloganya, mme ga di a sekasekwa tsotlhe ke motho yo o buang puo eo.
guide.limits.demo: Demo e ka dirisiwa ke mongwe le mongwe, ka jalo o se ka wa tsenya tshedimosetso ya sephiri mo go yone.
